prOriginal.nota: Found via gh search prs 'Localization fallbacks'. Merged with a regular merge: the benchmark head ecfa17b5 is the 2nd of 7 PR commits and is on upstream history. Later PR commits (650eb86 'Disable in development (server)') made the FallbackLocaleList production-only, but the translate/cache code and set_locale ensure_loaded! of the benchmark head were merged unchanged.

feature-localization-fallbacks-server-si.reason: PR #3786 'FIX: Load fallback locales in Sidekiq jobs' added I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded! right after I18n.locale = SiteSetting.default_locale in Jobs::Base#perform, so jobs (and the mailers they run) load the fallback catalogs. Today app/jobs/base.rb still calls I18n.ensure_all_loaded! after setting the locale, and execute_reload in translate_accelerator.rb also calls ensure_all_loaded!.

The cache key in translate_no_override is still key+locale+backend id today, but commit ec2f3169 ('FIX: Using the default_locale in locale fallbacks caused problems', citing multisite missing translations) removed SiteSetting.default_locale from FallbackLocaleList; the chain is now locale, its static LocaleSiteSetting.fallback_locale chain, then :en, so cached fallback results no longer depend on any site setting. The dependency had been dropped by the 2015-11-13 refactor 3720783 and re-added on 2018-01-22 (ce060e2) before this final removal.

astra.pergunta: confirmado by ec2f3169 (2020-05-06) or descontinuado (3720783 refactor 2015 / ec2f3169)?
astra.resposta: confirmado - ec2f3169 deliberately removed site-dependent default_locale fallbacks, eliminating the mismatch; the 2015 refactor was only temporary since the behaviour returned in 2018.
